checkConstraints.name: recovery_reviewer_not_subject
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((reviewed_by IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NULL) OR (reviewed_by <> user_id)))

checkConstraints.name: users_username_pair
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((username IS NULL) AND (username_skeleton IS NULL)) OR ((username IS NOT NULL) AND (username_skeleton IS NOT NULL))))

checkConstraints.name: ledger_accounts_scope
checkConstraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE account_type
    WHEN 'USER_ESCROW_LIABILITY'::ledger.ledger_account_type THEN ((trade_id IS NOT NULL) AND (owner_user_id IS NULL) AND (payout_id IS NULL))
    WHEN 'USER_PAYABLE'::ledger.ledger_account_type THEN ((owner_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (trade_id IS NULL) AND (payout_id IS NULL))
    WHEN 'SETTLEMENT_CLEARING'::ledger.ledger_account_type THEN ((payout_id IS NOT NULL) AND (owner_user_id IS NULL) AND (trade_id IS NULL))
    ELSE ((owner_user_id IS NULL) AND (trade_id IS NULL) AND (payout_id IS NULL))
END)

checkConstraints.name: trade_state_changes_actor_identified
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((actor_id IS NOT NULL) OR (actor_type = ANY (ARRAY['SYSTEM'::trade.trade_actor_type, 'LEDGER'::trade.trade_actor_type]))))

checkConstraints.name: trade_terms_delivery_address_shape
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((delivery_address ?& ARRAY['street'::text, 'landmark'::text, 'recipient'::text, 'state_id'::text, 'city_id'::text]) AND (length(COALESCE((delivery_address ->> 'street'::text), ''::text)) > 0) AND (length(COALESCE((delivery_address ->> 'recipient'::text), ''::text)) > 0) AND (length(COALESCE((delivery_address ->> 'state_id'::text), ''::text)) > 0) AND (length(COALESCE((delivery_address ->> 'city_id'::text), ''::text)) > 0)))

checkConstraints.name: trade_terms_ships_from_address_shape
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((ships_from_address ?& ARRAY['street'::text, 'landmark'::text, 'recipient'::text, 'state_id'::text, 'city_id'::text]) AND (length(COALESCE((ships_from_address ->> 'street'::text), ''::text)) > 0) AND (length(COALESCE((ships_from_address ->> 'recipient'::text), ''::text)) > 0) AND (length(COALESCE((ships_from_address ->> 'state_id'::text), ''::text)) > 0) AND (length(COALESCE((ships_from_address ->> 'city_id'::text), ''::text)) > 0)))

checkConstraints.name: trades_fee_snapshot_arithmetic
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((fee_schedule_version IS NULL) OR ((item_amount_minor > 0) AND (buyer_protection_fee_minor >= 0) AND (commission_minor >= 0) AND (seller_proceeds_minor >= 0) AND (buyer_total_minor = (item_amount_minor + buyer_protection_fee_minor)) AND (seller_proceeds_minor = (item_amount_minor - commission_minor)) AND (platform_revenue_minor = (buyer_protection_fee_minor + commission_minor)))))

checkConstraints.name: trades_fee_snapshot_complete
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((num_nonnulls(fee_schedule_version, item_amount_minor, buyer_protection_fee_minor, buyer_total_minor, commission_minor, seller_proceeds_minor, platform_revenue_minor, fee_snapshot, fees_snapshotted_at) = ANY (ARRAY[0, 9])))

checkConstraints.name: trades_fees_before_payment
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((fee_schedule_version IS NOT NULL) OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::trade.trade_status, 'PENDING_COUNTERPARTY'::trade.trade_status, 'UNDER_PROPOSAL_REVIEW'::trade.trade_status, 'AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE'::trade.trade_status, 'DECLINED'::trade.trade_status, 'REJECTED'::trade.trade_status, 'CANCELLED'::trade.trade_status, 'EXPIRED'::trade.trade_status]))))

checkConstraints.name: trades_initiator_side
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((initiator_role = 'BUYER'::trade.trade_initiator_role) AND (buyer_user_id = initiator_user_id)) OR ((initiator_role = 'SELLER'::trade.trade_initiator_role) AND (seller_user_id = initiator_user_id))))

checkConstraints.name: trades_parties_bound
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((buyer_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (seller_user_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::trade.trade_status, 'PENDING_COUNTERPARTY'::trade.trade_status, 'EXPIRED'::trade.trade_status, 'CANCELLED'::trade.trade_status]))))

checkConstraints.name: trades_parties_distinct
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((buyer_user_id IS NULL) OR (seller_user_id IS NULL) OR (buyer_user_id <> seller_user_id)))

checkConstraints.name: trades_terms_before_payment
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((accepted_terms_version_id IS NOT NULL) OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::trade.trade_status, 'PENDING_COUNTERPARTY'::trade.trade_status, 'UNDER_PROPOSAL_REVIEW'::trade.trade_status, 'AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE'::trade.trade_status, 'DECLINED'::trade.trade_status, 'REJECTED'::trade.trade_status, 'CANCELLED'::trade.trade_status, 'EXPIRED'::trade.trade_status]))))
